## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to quantify value and risk for cross-tenant data sharing under strict privacy regimes using data clean rooms.

## Key Concepts

- Privacy-by-design cost modeling
- Governance, audits, and compliance penalties
- Multi-region data-transfer and encryption costs
- Go/No-Go criteria and break-even analysis

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo-CBA net-benefit calculator
function netBenefit(revenueUplift, totalCosts, penalties){
  return revenueUplift - totalCosts - penalties;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would regional privacy laws affect cost components and risk scoring?
- What metrics would you track to validate ongoing business case after launch?

import numpy as np

## Why This Is Asked

This tests how to quantify edge security features within cost and regulatory constraints, plus rollout risk.

## Key Concepts

- Client-side policy engines
- DLP trade-offs: FP/FN, latency, UX
- Signed bundle updates and rollback
- Regional compliance costs and penalties
- Break-even and milestone planning

## Code Example

```javascript
function breEstimate(revenueLeakAvoided, costs, overhead) {
  return (revenueLeakAvoided - costs) / (overhead || 1);
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
